snippet.title: Island Keeper - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
🌱 Build the ultimate eco-adventure and bring dead islands back to life! Try the Island Keeper Demo on PC (Steam), available June 12: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3943490/Island_Keeper_Demo/

Island Keeper puts you in the role of Ferrum-1, an AI robot sent to clean up a polluted archipelago. Collect trash, recycle it into resources, craft tools, and build your own base while the world reacts to everything you do. Explore by foot, speedboat, and submarine, meet the wildlife and natives that call the islands home, and uncover a mystery hidden beneath the waves. Try the demo now, with the full game coming to PC in 2026 and to Xbox Series X|S and PlayStation 5 in 2027.

#IslandKeeper #Simulation #Adventure #IndieGame #Steam #PCGaming
